ai_edit.title: Adjust with AI
ai_edit.subtitle: — tell it what to change and the AI edits only that part
ai_edit.what_to_change: What do you want to change?
ai_edit.ph: E.g.: In the objection, the customer should demand to speak with a supervisor before accepting the solution. And at the closing, have them ask about delivery time so the agent has to quote the 5-business-day window.
ai_edit.hint: The more concrete, the better: say WHICH moment bothers you and HOW it should read. The AI only rewrites what you asked for; the rest of the simulation stays untouched.
ai_edit.focus_hint: Optional. Picking moments focuses the AI there and makes the edit more precise and faster; otherwise it decides where to touch.

"{{correction}}"

Apply the correction on top of what exists now. Do NOT undo what already works nor go back to the previous version: change only what the correction requires.

survey.title: How did the course go?
survey.lead: It takes 30 seconds and your answer is anonymous. Once you send it, you'll see your certificate.
survey.lead_retro: You finished this course before this survey existed. Answer it once and you're back to your certificate: it keeps its original date and verification code.
survey.q1_instructor: 👩‍🏫 From 0 to 10, how clear and helpful was the person who delivered this training and what they shared with you?
survey.q1_campaign: 📚 From 0 to 10, how relevant and useful did you find the content and materials of this training?
survey.q2_training: 🚀 From 0 to 10, how would you rate your overall experience in this training?
survey.q2_content: 🚀 From 0 to 10, how would you rate your overall experience with this course?
survey.q3: 🗣️ We want to keep improving. Share your ideas, suggestions or comments about this training. We're listening! 😊
survey.q3_placeholder: For example: a topic you wish we had gone deeper into.
survey.followup: We're sorry it wasn't the best experience. What happened?
survey.followup_placeholder: What you tell us here is what lets us fix it.
survey.required_hint: Answer all three questions to continue.
survey.thanks: Thank you! Your feedback has been recorded.
survey.expired_hint: No problem: start again with a fresh clock. Your certificate is still waiting for you.
survey.send_error: We couldn't send your answer. What you wrote is still here — please try again.
